title: Result of contact.list
description: Request args: {"cursor": record to start at, optional}. The stored contacts from the cursor on, in record order, up to 6 per page and fewer when a page would not fit the result limit. The cursor is a record number, which a contact keeps while it is stored, so adds and removals between pages never skip or repeat a contact that stays. A shared secret and the path bytes are never in a result. Companion only.

type.description: Never none: type 0 is the anonymous slot's and is not a stored contact.

fav.description: The native favourite flag: the contact is protected from the oldest-first eviction.

last_advert.description: Their clock at their last advert.

hops.description: Hops of the known path; -1: none, the contact is reached by flood.

next.description: The cursor of the next page, or null after the last contact.
